Wind Symphony presents "Music with Friends"

Wed, September 30, 2026
7:30 pm - 9:00 pm
Weigel Auditorium

1866 College Rd Columbus OH 43210

Google Yahoo! Outlook.com Office.com iCal / MS Outlook

The Wind Symphony opens its 2026–2027 season with a concert featuring special guest artists and composers. From Year to Year, Katahj Copley; Emblems, Aaron Copland; World Premiere: Trilliums on Grindstone, Aaron Perrine, featuring Katherine Borst Jones, flute; Concerto Classico, Joseph Horovitz, featuring Henry Mautner and Russel C. Mikkelson, trumpets; Consortium Premiere: Adventures in Wonderland, Erika Svanoe.

Russel C. Mikkelson, conductor; Paul Bissler (Year to Year) and Brooke Woods (Concerto), graduate conductors; Aaron Perrine (Trilliums) and Erika Svanoe (Adventures), guest composers; Katherine Borst Jones, flute soloist; Henry Mautner and Russel Mikkelson, trumpets.

This concert is free and open to the public. No ticket required.

Livestream broadcast begins at 7:30 p.m.

  • A digital program link will be posted prior to the event.


All events are subject to change.

Getting Here

Directions and Parking

Ohio Union South Garage (open to visitors 24/7) — located just south of the Timashev Music building, next to the Ohio Union. 

  • A good choice for events in Weigel Auditorium, just inside the south end of the building, across from the Oval.
  • The only choice for visitors M–F, before 4 p.m.

Weigel Auditorium is on the second floor, via a staircase in the south lobby.

  • The elevator to Weigel Auditorium is in the back hallway, located behind the Music Commons.
